items.difficulty_reason: For h : Z -> X formally unramified of spaces over S and an etale commutative square V -> U over Z -> X, the lemma states V -> U is formally unramified and the universal first order thickening V' of V over U is etale over Z'; consequently C_{Z/X}|_V = C_{V/U}. The retained proof is the two-citation assembly: formal unramifiedness of V -> U is the chapter's preservation lemma (lemma formally-unramified); the identification of V' with the pullback chart over Z' follows from the compatibility of universal thickenings with etale base change (lemma universal-thickening-over-formally-etale) composed with the functoriality of the induced morphism of universal thickenings along etale squares (lemma etale-morphism-of-universal-thickenings), both cited to label; the conormal equality is then the standard identification of the conormal sheaf with pullback along an etale morphism of thickenings. Retained author proof at lines 3327-3334.
